```{r usgs_daily_data}

# Daily average of discharge, gage, temperature, pH, and specific conductance from daily data

usgs_daily_raw <- 
  
  read_waterdata_daily(
  monitoring_location_id = c("USGS-12301933", "USGS-12302055", "USGS-12304500",
                             "USGS-12305000", "USGS-12307750", "USGS-12310100",
                             "USGS-12322000", "USGS-12303500", "USGS-12301919"),
  parameter_code = c("00060", "00065", "00010", "00400", "00095"),
  time = c("2018-03-28", "2023-09-14"))

# Processed

usgs_daily_processed <- usgs_daily_raw %>% 
  mutate(year = year(time),
         month = month(time),
         day = day(time),
         season = case_when(month %in% c(3,4,5) ~ "Spring",
                            month %in% c(8,9,10) ~ "Fall")) %>% 
  na.omit(season) %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(
    cols = monitoring_location_id, 
    delim = "USGS-", 
    names = c("holder", "usgs_site_number")) %>%
  mutate(parameter = case_when(parameter_code == "00060" ~ "discharge",
                               parameter_code == "00065" ~ "gage_height",
                               parameter_code == "00010" ~ "temperature",
                               parameter_code == "00400" ~ "pH",
                               parameter_code == "00095" ~ "specific_conductance")) %>% 
  group_by(year, season, usgs_site_number, parameter) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(value)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = mean) %>% 
  select(-pH)

```

#Create df of unique sites and dates
continuous_fcn_df_test <- water_processed %>% 
  filter(sample_type != "Se(part)") %>% 
  distinct(usgs_site_number, date) %>% 
  mutate(usgs_site_number_full = paste0("USGS-", usgs_site_number)) %>% 
  select(usgs_site_number_full, usgs_site_number, date) 

 
#Function to pull gage height (00065) 
cont_gage_fcn_test <- function(usgs_site_number_full, date) {
  
tryCatch({
 gage <- read_waterdata_continuous(
    monitoring_location_id = usgs_site_number_full,
    parameter_code = "00065",
    time = as.POSIXct(c(date, date+1), tzone = "America/New_York"),
    properties = "value")  %>% 
   summarise(gage = (mean(value)))
 
 return(as.numeric(gage))},
 
 error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Failed to retrieve site:", usgs_site_number_full))
    return(NULL)
  })
    
}

continuous_fcn_df_test <- continuous_fcn_df_test %>% 
  mutate(gage = map2(usgs_site_number_full, date, cont_gage_fcn_test))
